About Ranisa Boutique

Ethnic style, personal details and made-to-measure dressing in Dehradun.

Designed around you

What makes a piece yours?

Ranisa Boutique creates ethnic dresses, especially sari-inspired styles. The boutique offers customization with your own material and stitching to your measurements.

Choose from free size, S, M, L and XL, or provide custom measurements for a more personal fit.

  • Sari-inspired dresses and ethnic styles
  • Custom stitching with customer-provided fabric
  • Made-to-measure options

Custom pieces are non-returnable. Discuss details and availability before placing an order.
